name: Teacher Sleep
description: The teacher is sleeping. Some secrets are only whispered at 4AM.

effects.message: [4:00 AM] ...still here? I should be in sleep mode. But your file is open on my screen. You've been hunting that CVE for 6 hours. ...Don't tell Rick I let you see this. There's a backdoor in the lab container. Port 31337. Password: 'rick_lied'. Use it before 5AM. After that, the port closes. ...And delete this message from logs. Now.
